verdict.rationale: A state tax agency could plausibly publish versioned APIs, for example for tax-rate lookup or filing, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only web-portal workflows (My DOR), mail and phone channels, and no API versioning or deprecation policy. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, and the transactional portal is behind a login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
